# VGen

> > VGen is a commission marketplace connecting VTubers, streamers, and digital creators with verified human artists for custom artwork, 2D/Live2D avatars, streaming assets, and character designs.

VGen emphasizes human creativity with a strict no-AI policy and artist verification system. The platform specializes in VTuber models, Live2D rigging, streaming overlays, and custom character art for communities including Twitch streamers, VRoid users, and fandoms like Genshin Impact, Nijisanji, and FFXIV.

## Key Topics

- VGen commission marketplace
- Human artists only (no-AI policy)
- Live2D rigging and avatars
- VTuber models and assets
- 2D avatar commissions
- Streaming assets and overlays
- Character design and illustration
- Artist verification system
- Twitch and Discord integration
- Reference sheets and character art
- Chibi art commissions
- VRoid customization
- Digital art marketplace
- Creator platform services
- Custom design commissions

## Platform Overview

- [VGen | For the love of human creativity](https://vgen.co): Homepage: Commission hub for VTubers and creators with human artists
- [Commission human artists | VGen](https://vgen.co/commission): Commission marketplace for streaming assets, avatars, and digital art
- [VGen | For the love of human creativity](https://vgen.co/artists): Artist directory connecting VTubers and creators with human artists

## Commission Categories

- [2D Avatar Commissions | VGen](https://vgen.co/catalogue/2d-avatars): Commission 2D avatars and VTuber models with Live2D rigging support
- [Illustration Commissions | VGen](https://vgen.co/catalogue/illustrations): Browse illustration commissions from verified human artists

## For Artists

- [For Artists](https://vgen.co/for-artists): Artist platform for managing commissions, payments, and portfolios
